project.name: OOP Navigators day one
project.brief: Out of Pocket is expanding, fast, and is now running more big projects at once than any newsletter company should. This is one of them. OOP is launching OOP Navigators, a phone team that helps health plan members understand their insurance. 40 navigators start on the same day, Monday, Nov 2. Every one of them has already quit their old job, so the date is not moving. The project tracker says things are mostly on track. Your job is to figure out what's really going on before day one
project.company: Out of Pocket Health, a healthcare newsletter and events company that is now expanding into a lot of things at once
project.product: OOP Navigators, a new 40-person phone team that helps health plan members understand their insurance

tickets.title: Navigator culture and values
tickets.desc: Build a culture of radical ownership and member obsession from day one. Our nine values should feel authentic, aspirational, and actionable, and show up in every call, every huddle, and every Slack emoji. Want this to be a living framework that grows with the team rather than a poster. Will co-create with the first cohort once they're onboarded. More to come

notes.title: Navigators day one readiness

Training groups, seating, and pods: Ari is waiting on Joelle, Joelle is waiting on Renee, Renee is waiting on Ari. Renee asked everyone to "stay flexible"
Marty is setting up 40 laptops and 280 logins the weekend before day one. Marty wasn't here because he was fixing someone's printer

Benefits: Cy says 90% done. The last part is that coverage doesn't start until Jan 1
Managers: Kendra asked who each new hire reports to. The ticket says TBD after hiring. Hiring finished 2 weeks ago
Training room: marked done. Ari checked the booking during the meeting. It's for Dec 2 through Dec 13
Two emails are going to the same 40 people, Sol's welcome email and Kendra's first day email. Agreed to keep them "consistent"
Parking and badges: nobody owns it. Three hires have asked
Renee mentioned that Lakeshore Health Plan's legal team is "still reviewing" the contract this team was hired to staff, "but that's a formality." Moved on to hoodies
Day one stays Nov 2. Everyone has already quit their old jobs
